note: committed defaults; live values may be overridden at runtime by the THRESHOLDS_JSON env var (shadow mode). CI always tests these defaults.
shadow_note: signal ids that run in shadow: evaluated, written to alerts/state.json and incidents/, named in the silent digest, but demoted to digest so they cannot page, sound or open the hot loop. detect/signals/__init__.py SHADOW_NEVER refuses 10/11/15/4b/S-F/S-X whatever this list says. INV-10 and INV-11 are here because every fire either produces on the committed ledger belongs to one creator labelled benign, and invoke rewards have been paused since 2026-08-21 13:51 UTC so there is no traffic to calibrate on. A person takes them out of shadow after re-measuring on post-un-pause data.
incident_mode_note: more than this many loud (page/notify) findings pending in one run switches notify/telegram.py to incident mode: one loud header, every finding silent beneath it. An incident ends only after six hours with nothing loud (INCIDENT_TTL_S), never on a single quiet run. See the council decision of 2026-08-23.

balance_watch.note: exit-leg balance watch floors (S-X). drop_* = minimum decrease that fires notify, in token units; MENTE uses the MOCA-equivalent floor. deposit_min = any receipt above this at an exchange_deposit address fires notify. cashout_sound_min = the floor an ARRIVAL must clear before it counts as 'the first cash-out' for incident-mode sounding; deposit_min is dust, and without this floor one dust transfer burns the siren for the whole incident.

escalation_note: Who runs this bot and can add someone to the on-call list. This is NOT the kill switch: Po cannot stop a Treasury payout. notify/commands.py names this person when it refuses a command, so a colleague who is turned away has a route in.

kill_switch.note: The platform person who can pause one creator's rewards. On 2026-08-20, 2,400,000 of the 2,660,046 MOCA left AFTER the first alert fired: authority, not lead time, was the bottleneck. owner, contact, commitment_min and agreed_ts must be filled together, from a real commitment recorded in council/un-pause-runbook.md in the private repo. If any is empty, or the owner still reads interim/TBD/UNASSIGNED, every page prints the UNASSIGNED block loudly. Do not fill these in to make that line go away. This file is PUBLIC: prefer setting the block through the THRESHOLDS_JSON secret so the one person who can stop the money is named in the group and not on the internet.
